title: Copilot Studio: Dataverse tables as a native knowledge source for agents
summary: Hold: the availability control stops at a section containing two different search options, and its advertised automation only reads the setting rather than changing it. The caution that agent credit limits are unconfirmed for Dataverse knowledge is also misleading: Microsoft documents those limits for each Copilot Studio agent. The roadmap facts and the principal knowledge-source, authentication and billing statements are supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans native Dataverse knowledge grounding in Copilot Studio using structured enterprise records and business data.
claims.quote: We are enabling Microsoft Dataverse as a native knowledge source in Copilot Studio, expanding the platform’s ability to ground AI agents in structured enterprise data.
